meta.name: agf-writing-change
meta.description: Use when product-lead is about to formalize a feature into a change folder (the OpenSpec-style intake that replaces PRD as of v6.9.0). Provides the four-artifact structure (proposal / delta specs / design / tasks), the Requirement+Scenario delta format (ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED), the AC↔scenario mapping that keeps the AGF verification spine intact, the validate gate, and the archive-merge hand-off. Replaces agf-writing-prd (deprecated).

copy.tagline: 把功能需求整理成标准化的变更文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们团队用 OpenSpec 格式管理产品需求
